system.description: A swift-moving river without a bridge crossing, deep enough to sweep away most people.
system.notes:
Standard | Traversal

A swift-moving river without a bridge crossing, deep enough to sweep away most people.
Impulses: Bar crossing, carry away the unready, divide the land

Difficulty: 10

Features

Dangerous Crossing - Passive: Crossing the river requires the party to complete a Progress Countdown (4). A PC who rolls a failure with Fear is immediately targeted by the “Undertow” action without requiring a Fear to be spent on the feature.

Undertow - Action: Spend a Fear to catch a PC in the undertow. They must make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 1d6+1 physical damage and are moved a Close distance down the river, becoming Vulnerable until they get out of the river. On a success, they must mark a Stress.

Patient Hunter - Action: Spend a Fear to summon a beast within Close range of a chosen PC. The beast appears in or near the river and immediately takes the spotlight to use one of their features.
